title: clappertonia polyandra
intro: Clappertonia polyandra, commonly known as the "Tournesol" or "Safflower", is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Clappertonia polyandra are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body, making it a popular remedy for anxiety and stress relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
